_comment: Ceilings for the scheduled Locust smoke run (.github/workflows/perf-smoke.yml), checked by scripts/check_perf_budget.py. Set deliberately with wide headroom: a shared CI runner is noisy, so these catch a dead backend or a 10x regression, not a 10% drift. There is no --update-baseline on purpose — a budget must never absorb a regression by being rewritten from the run that broke it. Calibrated against a real 40s run at 10 users with chat skipped (70 health requests at p95 3ms, 20 feedback at p95 39ms); CI runs 60s, so the request floors sit well below what a healthy run produces and only a dead or crawling backend trips them.
